text:
olivia_csm: Heads up — Brightline flagged a 0.6% uptime drop in their onboarding window last week. They asked where that shows up on the report and whether this triggers a credit. tagging @kevin_se and @maria_support to sync.
kevin_se: thanks. what window exactly? daily or rolling 30d? any latency regressions too or strictly availability?
olivia_csm: rolling 7d window from Mar 8–14. latency was fine overall but saw a few 95th pct spikes tied to cold starts. customer called out uptime number specifically.
maria_support: I pulled logs — three infra-scale failures during a deployment job, two of which recovered within 90s. opsbot posted the incident notice. link: https://internal.redwood/alerts/BU-4987
opsbot: ALERT: Service group "brightline-prod" reported 99.4% uptime (Mar 8–14). Incident IDs: INC-9832, INC-9833. Auto-triage: deployment-hot-restart.
kevin_se: ok, sounds like small outages but customer-facing. For credit calc we use our SLA clause: credit = downtime% * monthly commit. Quick calc: 0.6% * $50k/mo = $300. We should confirm proration rules and whether onboarding commitments are treated differently.
sam_eng: FYI we rolled a config that disabled aggressive prefix caching during that deploy — that likely increased cold-starts. I can backport a safe tweak to the autoscaler tonight to reduce window of impact.
maria_support: i'll own the comms. draft proposal: apology + explanation + proposed credit + mitigation plan + timing for fix. want signoff before sending.
olivia_csm: thanks. can we add a short writeup for the customer dashboard that shows the incident timeline and the credit calc? they asked for the math broken down.
kevin_se: i'll drop the calc and a tiny table into the draft. snippet: ```Credit = (target_uptime - observed_uptime) / target_uptime * monthly_commit = (99.99 - 99.4) / 99.99 * 50000 ≈ $300``` needs legal to ok final language but good for customer visibility.
maria_support: drafting now. proposed send window: tomorrow 10am PT after we push the autoscaler tweak tonight. cc @sam_eng to confirm deploy plan.
sam_eng: confirm — will push safe tweak at 0200 PT, smoke test, and post results in this thread.
olivia_csm: perfect. action items: 1) sam deploy + smoke test (0200 PT) 2) kevin finalizes calc + dashboard snippet 3) maria drafts comms and sends at 10am PT once ops confirms. I'll prep the renewal risk note for AE if we need to escalate.
kevin_se: noted. if legal flags wording we may soften credit phrasing to "credit estimate" until approved. :+1:
maria_support: draft ready, pinging for review in #docs-review in 30m.
opsbot: DEPLOYMENT: autoscaler-tweak pushed by sam_eng at 2162005600. Status: scheduled.
olivia_csm: thanks team — keeping this thread as the single source for customer-facing items. I'll update renewal risk tracker if the customer expresses concern after the note."
